title: Your GitHub README Isn't a Profile. It's a Storefront. (Here Are the 5 Rules I Used
why_read: A personal opinion piece on structuring a GitHub README for marketing purposes offers little technical substance.
analysis: This article is advice-style content about treating a GitHub profile README like a product landing page rather than a decorative résumé. It's a reasonable personal branding tip but contains no real technical content, code architecture, or engineering insight. The piece reads largely as self-promotion for the author's own apps and profile. Low value for a technical digest focused on substantive engineering topics.
